checks: Empty page writes directly, manual attachment without pre-registering collection
Local drafts survive reload, stay out of workbench sync and public preview
Detached collection attachment excludes notes and keeps content after collection edits
Explicit candidate preview and public renderer agree; private draft never copied
Atomic final save failure retains old feed and local draft, then retry succeeds
Storage CAS preserves competing post and edit draft; new-copy recovery
Backup copy remaps post IDs and preserves attachments/source bundle
Visible conflict recovery reloads page without losing draft and saves a new copy
Draft download/import and local CAS preserve both inputs; foreign account denied
Korean composition preserves input and explicit URL failure returns to manual attachment
Local draft write failure blocks navigation and preserves visible input until retry
Discarding an edit draft preserves the saved post; empty drafts are reused
Many mixed Korean posts, keyboard picker and narrow-screen feed
